# QrSortable - Smart QR Code Storage & Organizing Labels

> QrSortable connects physical QR code labels to digital inventory records (contents, high-resolution photos, notes, locations, and categories) so households, movers, warehouses, event teams, and small businesses know what is inside every box before opening it.
